full_prompt_en: A square monochrome etching presents a close side profile of a face turned toward the left, printed as a dark rectangular image within a generous cream paper border. The upper-left portion of the printed plate remains pale and lightly scratched, leaving space before the sharply drawn nose. The eye sits high near the middle, partly lowered beneath a deep black brow and an intensely shaded upper lid. From that dark area, the cheekbone and long nose descend through overlapping fine gray lines. The nose projects toward the left and casts a dense triangular dark shape beneath it. Full lips meet near the lower center, their rounded highlights held against a dark crease, while chin and jaw trail out of the bottom edge. Dense curls or dark hair occupy the upper-right and right margins, joining the deep shadow along the cheek and neck. The portrait is cropped so closely that clothing and setting are absent. Tiny scratches, cross-hatching, and uneven ink deposits build the skin's midtones; some marks remain visibly sharp while others gather into a soft charcoal-like haze. The viewpoint is a strict profile, with the face filling nearly the entire printed rectangle. A pale apparent light from the left catches the nose ridge, eyelid, and lips, while the right side dissolves into accumulated dark lines. The rectangular plate has a defined straight edge, but the surrounding unprinted paper has a warm, slightly textured tone. The composition is quiet and concentrated, balancing a pale open zone on the left against richly worked black hatching and the reflective stillness of the profile.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色蚀刻画把一张朝左的近距离侧脸，印在宽阔奶油色纸边框内的深色矩形画版上。画版左上部分保持浅淡，仅有轻轻刮线，为轮廓明确的鼻子前方留下空间。眼睛位于中间偏高处，在深黑眉弓和浓阴上眼睑下半垂。脸颊骨与长鼻由那片深色向下延伸，细灰线互相叠合。鼻尖向左凸出，下面形成浓重的三角暗面。饱满嘴唇在下方中央附近相接，圆润高光紧挨着深色唇缝，颏与下颌则伸出底边。浓密卷发般的深色形态占据右上与右边缘，并接到脸颊和颈部的重阴。肖像裁得很近，衣服和场景都不入画。细小刮痕、交叉排线与不均匀墨层构建皮肤中间调；有些笔痕依然锋利，有些则聚成木炭般柔雾。视点是严格侧面，脸几乎填满整个印刷矩形。来自左方的浅淡光感照到鼻梁、眼睑和嘴唇，右侧逐渐溶入积累的深色线条。矩形印版有明确的直边，周围未印区域是暖而略带肌理的纸色。构图安静而集中，以左侧浅色开放区域，对照细密黑色排线与侧影沉静的反光。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome intaglio-print treatment builds tone from fine scratches, cross-hatching, and uneven deposits of dark ink. Warm cream paper surrounds a sharply bounded rectangular working area. Inside it, near-white spaces give breathing room to dense black concentrations and many intermediate grays. Short etched lines stay crisp at selected edges, then accumulate into velvety shadow and granular transitions. A pale left-side light catches raised forms, while the opposite side becomes a closely worked dark mass. The crop is intimate and asymmetrical, with a broad light interval balancing the darkest region. Visible paper texture and imperfect ink make the result tactile, thoughtful, and quietly severe.
style_prompt_zh: 单色凹版印刷效果以细刮线、交叉排线和不均匀深墨沉积建立色调。暖奶油色纸张环绕边界清楚的矩形工作区域。其内，近白留白给密集黑色和诸多中灰留出呼吸。短促蚀刻线在部分边缘保持锋利，随后积成天鹅绒般的阴影与颗粒过渡。左侧浅色光感照亮隆起形态，另一侧则成为线痕密集的深色体。裁切亲密且不对称，大片浅色间隔平衡最深区域。可见纸纹与不完美墨层使结果可触、沉思且含蓄严肃。
theme_en: A close etched profile of a contemplative face on cream paper
theme_zh: 奶油色纸面上一张沉思侧脸的精细蚀刻画
name: Etching
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
